name: the Learn path (home)

regions_read.text: SECTION 1, UNIT 1 / Order at a café
regions_read.verdict_on_region: content: names the course unit being studied, not a part of the app
icon-only bottom tab bar; the current tab is drawn inside a light-blue rounded box — pixel-read active state (never declared selected:true)

identifier_found: the house tab drawn inside a light-blue rounded box in the bottom bar; above the path the unit banner 'SECTION 1, UNIT 1 / Order at a café'
initial_rationale: the bottom tab bar visibly highlights the house (Learn) tab; the unit banner names the course unit rather than the section, so the highlight carries the location

test_cases.precondition: app open on the Learn path (house tab highlighted)
test_cases.action: scroll the path down twice the captured distance and back; then tap the treasure-chest tab, the trophy tab and the ⋯ tab in turn, watching the light-blue highlight
test_cases.expected_result: the highlight either follows the tapped tab or stays fixed
test_cases.confirms_if: the highlight never moves, or disappears while the path is shown
test_cases.overturns_if: the highlight follows the tab (moves to the chest on Quests, to the trophy on Leaderboards)
test_cases.observed_result: Scrolling: the unit banner and the tab bar stayed pinned; 'Greet people and say goodbye' / 'JUMP HERE?' scrolled past underneath. Tabs: the light-blue box moved to the chest on the Quests screen ('Quests' title) and to the trophy on the Leaderboards screen; back on Learn it returned to the house.

deciding_evidence: live: the highlight moved with every tab tapped and stayed pinned with the banner while the path scrolled — a working active state, pixel-rendered though never declared selected:true
